DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱を発送するご相談ですね。中に入っている物を具体的に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss shipping this box. Please tell me specifically what's inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 修理に出す小さな機器です。道具とだけ書こうと思いましたが、電池が入っているので詳しく伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 修理機器に電池が入っており道具だけでなく詳しく説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a small device I'm sending for repair. I was going to write just 'tools,' but it contains a battery, so I'll explain in detail.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the device for repair contains a battery, so you will describe it in detail instead of writing only 'tools.' Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電池の種類と機器の状態を確認する必要があります。説明書はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the battery type and the condition of the device. Do you have the instruction manual?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 説明書の写真があります。電池を外せるかも自分では分からないので、この表示を見て相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 説明書写真を示し電池を外せるか不明なため表示を見て相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo of the manual. I don't know whether I can remove the battery myself, so I'd like to look at this label and ask your advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the photo of the manual and explain that you want advice based on the label because you do not know whether the battery can be removed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分からないまま外さず、表示を確認しましょう。送付先は修理の案内に書かれた住所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the label without removing it while we're unsure. Is the destination the address in the repair instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内の住所です。ただ、国内か海外かを宛先で確かめていなかったので、先に案内を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 修理案内の住所が国内か海外かをまだ確かめていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it's the address in those instructions. But I haven't checked whether the destination is in Japan or overseas, so I'll reread the instructions first.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not yet checked whether the address in the repair instructions is in Japan or overseas. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先と内容によって条件を確認します。箱はまだ開けられる状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the conditions based on the destination and contents. Can the box still be opened?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仮に閉じただけで、開けられます。梱包が十分だと思い込まず、必要な確認が済むまで封をしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仮閉じで開けられ梱包確認が済むまで封をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've only closed it temporarily, so it can be opened. I won't assume the packing is adequate or seal it until all the necessary checks are done.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the box is temporarily closed and can be opened, and that you will not seal it until the packing checks are complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 修理先の送付案内も見せてください。重さだけで方法を選ばず、内容に合う条件を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also show me the repair center's shipping instructions. Let's check the conditions appropriate for the contents instead of choosing a shipping method by weight alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送付案内と説明書をそろえます。機器と電池の情報を伝えて、発送できる方法と梱包を確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送付案内と説明書で機器電池情報を伝え方法と梱包を確認後に発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll get the shipping instructions and manual together. I'll provide the device and battery details and send it after checking an available shipping method and the packing.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will use the shipping instructions and manual to provide device and battery details, then ship it after checking the method and packing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、案内と表示から確認しましょう。大切な機器をお忘れなく、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's start by checking the instructions and labels. Don't forget your valuable device, and have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの季節の菓子をご覧ですね。ご自宅用でしょうか、お渡しになる予定がありますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at these seasonal sweets. Are they for your home, or are you planning to give them to someone?

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 週末に友人三人へ渡したいです。一人ずつ違う家に持ち帰るので、一つの大きい箱では困りそうです。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 週末に三人へ渡し別々に持ち帰るため大箱を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to give them to three friends this weekend. Each friend will take theirs to a different home, so one large box would be inconvenient.
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to avoid one large box because you will give sweets to three people this weekend and each will take theirs home separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さい箱を三つにする案がありますね。今日お買いになると、渡す日まで置いておくことになりますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: One option is three small boxes. If you buy them today, will you need to keep them until the day you give them out?

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日から二日ほど置くつもりです。この菓子の表示を見て、渡す日まで持っておけるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二日ほど置く予定なので渡す日まで持てるか商品表示で確かめたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to keep them for about two days from today. I'd like to check the label on these sweets to see whether I can keep them until then.
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to store them for about two days and want to check the product label to see whether they will keep until the day you give them out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この練習用の表示では、日付がここにあります。お持ち帰り後の置き方も別の欄に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this practice label, the date is here. Storage instructions after taking them home are in a separate section.

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付を見ると今日買うのは早そうです。友人に会う日の朝に買うことを考えます。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示を見て今日は早いと考え会う当日の朝の購入を検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Looking at the date, today seems too early to buy them. I'll consider buying them on the morning I meet my friends.
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the label makes you think today is too early, and you are considering buying them on the morning you meet your friends. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その日の品ぞろえは今お約束できません。箱の大きさだけ先に決めて、来店時に中身を選ぶ案はいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can't promise now what will be in stock that day. How about deciding on the box size first and choosing the contents when you come in?

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱は小さい物を三つにします。中身が同じでなくてもよいので、その日に表示を見て選びます。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小箱三つにし中身は同一でなく当日の表示で選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll have three small boxes. The contents don't have to be identical, so I'll read the labels and choose them that day.
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want three small boxes and will choose the contents from that day's labels, even if they are not all identical. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お渡しの際に箱が混ざらないよう、宛名を付ける準備もできます。ご自分で書きますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also prepare name labels so the boxes don't get mixed up when you hand them out. Would you like to write them yourself?

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で友人の名前を書きます。今日は箱の見本だけ覚え、当日の朝に三つの中身を選びに来ます。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名を自分で書き箱の見本を覚えて当朝に三つ選びに来ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my friends' names myself. Today I'll just remember the sample box and come back that morning to choose the contents for all three.
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will write the names yourself, remember the sample box, and return that morning to choose the contents for three boxes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、小さい箱の見本をこちらでご覧ください。それでは、当日は品物の表示を見ながらまたご相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-FKO-IIZUKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please look at this sample of the small box. When you come that day, let's discuss your choices again while checking the product labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 外から梁を見上げていらっしゃいましたね。室内の展示もご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking up at the beams from outside. Would you like to see the indoor exhibits too?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 室内で梁の形を見たいです。長い傘を持っていますが、そのまま入ってよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 梁を室内で見たい目的と長傘を持つことを伝え持込めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the shape of the beams from inside. I have a long umbrella; may I bring it in with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to see the beams indoors and have a long umbrella, and ask whether you may bring it in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用展示では、傘は入口の傘立てへ置きます。靴についての案内板も入口にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this practice exhibit, umbrellas go in the stand at the entrance. There is also a sign about footwear at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 傘立てへ置きます。靴を脱ぐ所と、土間のまま歩ける所を見分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傘を置き土間と靴を脱ぐ区域を見分けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll put it in the umbrella stand. I'd like to distinguish the areas where I must take off my shoes from the earthen-floor areas where I can keep them on.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the umbrella and want to distinguish the earthen-floor areas from the areas where you must remove your shoes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内板の色が違います。土間は青、靴を脱いで上がる所は緑で示しています。進む前に表示を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The signs use different colors. Blue marks the earthen-floor areas, and green marks the raised areas where shoes must be removed. Check the signs before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 色の表示を見ます。梁を近くで見るために、置いてある踏み台に上がってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色の表示を確認し踏み台に上がって梁を見ることができるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the colored signs. May I step onto the stool there to see the beams up close?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the colored signs and ask whether you may stand on the stool to look at the beams. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示用の踏み台には上がらないでください。梁の形は、室内の図解でも見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't stand on the display stool. You can also see the beam shapes in the diagrams indoors.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 踏み台は使わず図解を見ます。図解にある仕組みがわからなければ、こちらで質問してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 踏み台を使わず図解を見て不明な所を質問できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look at the diagrams without using the stool. If I don't understand the structure shown in a diagram, may I ask questions here?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the diagrams without standing on the stool and ask whether you may ask about anything you do not understand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、どの部分が気になったか図を指してお聞きください。実物には手を触れずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please point to the part of the diagram you're curious about when asking. Please don't touch the actual objects.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 実物は触らず、図のわからない部分を指して質問します。帰るときには入口の傘も忘れず取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実物に触れず図で質問し帰りに傘を取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't touch the actual objects, and I'll point to the parts of the diagrams I don't understand to ask questions. I'll also remember to collect my umbrella at the entrance when I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask questions using the diagrams without touching the actual objects and collect your umbrella when leaving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、まず入口の表示をご覧ください。それでは、室内の見学をゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please look at the entrance signs first. Then take your time enjoying the indoor visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 別の工程を手伝ってほしいと連絡が来ました。いま包装の記録はどこまで終わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We've received a request for help with another process. How much of the packaging record have you completed?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午前の分は書きましたが、今扱っている箱の数はまだ記入していません。このまま移ってよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 午前は記入済みだが現在の箱の数量は未記入と述べ移動してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've written up the morning's work, but I haven't entered the number of boxes I'm handling now. May I move to the other process as things stand?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the morning's entries are complete but the current box quantity is not recorded, and ask whether you may move. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず未記入の部分があることを引継ぎましょう。数を確かめていないなら、推測して埋めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's hand over the fact that some entries are missing. If you haven't checked the quantity, don't fill it in by guessing.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 未確認の数は空欄のまま担当者に伝えます。移る先でも同じ作業着と手袋を使うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確認数量を空欄で伝え移動先の作業着と手袋について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll leave the unverified quantity blank and tell the person in charge. Will I use the same work clothes and gloves at the other process?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will report the unverified quantity with the entry left blank, and ask about work clothes and gloves at the new process. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 工程が違うので、同じでよいとは言えません。この練習では移動先の担当に準備を確認してから入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's a different process, so I can't say the same ones are acceptable. In this exercise, check the preparations with the person in charge there before entering.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認前に移動先へ入らず待ちます。いま使っている道具を一緒に持って行く必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認前に入らず待ち使用中の道具を持参する必要を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait without entering the new area until I've checked. Do I need to take the tools I'm using now with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait without entering before checking, and ask whether you need to bring the tools you are currently using. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道具の持出しもまだ決めていません。今の工程の指定場所に置いて、持って行かずに相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We haven't decided about moving the tools either. Put them in the designated place for this process and ask without taking them along.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道具は指定場所へ置きます。包装を続ける人には、どの箱の記録が空欄かも示してから離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具を指定場所に置き包装担当へ空欄がどの箱か示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put the tools in the designated place. Before leaving, I'll also show the person continuing the packaging which boxes have blank records.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the tools in the designated place and show the packaging worker which boxes have missing entries. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録用紙と箱を対応させて伝えてください。移動先の担当が迎えに来るまで、ここで準備の説明を待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Match the record sheet to the boxes when explaining. Let's wait here for instructions on preparations until the person from the other process comes to meet you.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 空欄の記録と箱を引き継ぎ、道具を持たずに待ちます。作業着と手袋の確認が済んでから新しい工程へ入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録と箱を引継ぎ道具を持たず着用物の確認後に工程へ入ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hand over the blank entries and corresponding boxes and wait without taking the tools. I'll enter the new process after the work clothes and gloves have been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will hand over the records and boxes, wait without taking tools, and enter the new process after checking the required clothing and gloves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、移動先の担当に確認してきます。戻ったら準備を一緒に確かめましょう。またここで声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll go and check with the person in charge there. When I return, let's check the preparations together. I'll speak to you here again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行の表示をご覧ですね。ご利用予定の便と、気になっている表示を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the service information. Please tell me which service you plan to take and which information concerns you.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この便で友人のいる駅へ行きます。十分遅れと表示されていますが、その時間で到着すると連絡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十分遅れを友人へ到着時刻として連絡してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm taking this service to the station where my friend is. It says ten minutes late. Can I tell my friend I'll arrive at that time?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may report the displayed ten-minute delay to your friend as a definite arrival time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用画面の遅れは今の状況で、到着を確約する表示ではありません。友人の方とはどこで待ち合わせていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The delay on this practice screen describes the current situation; it doesn't guarantee an arrival time. Where are you meeting your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前で車で待ってもらう予定です。到着時刻が決まったと思わせない伝え方にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅前で車の迎えがあり確定時刻と思わせず伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is planning to wait in a car in front of the station. I'd like to explain it without making the arrival time sound definite.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend is picking you up by car in front of the station and you want to avoid presenting the arrival time as definite. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在遅れが出ていて、到着は未確定だと分けて伝えられますね。別の便も比較する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can explain separately that there is currently a delay and that the arrival time is still uncertain. Are you planning to compare other services too?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の便は違う駅に着くので、乗り換える前に友人へ相談します。勝手に駅を変えるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別便は別駅に着くので友人に相談してから変えると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The other service arrives at a different station, so I'll consult my friend before switching. I want to avoid changing stations without asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the other service arrives at another station, so you will consult your friend before changing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅を変える場合は、迎えの場所も確認が必要ですね。いまの便で待つ間にも表示は更新されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you change stations, you'll need to confirm the pickup location too. The display will keep updating while you wait for this service.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示を見ながら待ちます。友人には今の遅れだけ先に知らせ、乗る便が決まったらもう一度連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示を見て待ち今の遅れを先に知らせ便決定後に再連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait while watching the display. I'll tell my friend about the current delay first and contact them again once I've decided which service to take.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait while checking the display, report the current delay first, and contact your friend again after choosing a service. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうすれば、今わかる情報と次の連絡を区別できますね。出発前には乗り場の表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will distinguish what you know now from your next update. Please also check the boarding location display before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の便の状況と未確定の到着を伝えます。別便に変えるなら、先に迎えの駅と場所を友人と決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着未確定を伝え別便なら迎えの駅と場所を先に決めると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the current status of this service and that the arrival time is uncertain. If I switch services, I'll first agree with my friend on the pickup station and location.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain the uncertain arrival time and, if changing services, first agree on the pickup station and location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、表示を確認しながらお待ちください。ご予定が決まりましたら、どうぞお気をつけてお出掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait while checking the display. Once your plans are settled, have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入口をお探しでしょうか。お持ちの券の入口欄をご覧いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the entrance? Could you look at the entrance section on your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の券は北入口ですが、友人の券は南入口です。二人で北から入れるのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人は北で友人は南の券なので一緒に北から入れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My ticket says north entrance, but my friend's says south entrance. I'd like to know whether we can both enter from the north.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your ticket is for the north entrance and your friend's for the south, and ask whether you may enter together from the north. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の券では、書かれた入口に分けて案内します。座席の区域も同じか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: For these practice tickets, we direct each person to the entrance printed on their ticket. Let's also check whether your seats are in the same section.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 席は同じ区域で、番号が隣同士です。入口だけ別なら、入った後に席で会うことを考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ区域の隣席と示し別々に入って席で会う案を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Our seats are in the same section, with consecutive numbers. If only the entrances differ, we'll consider meeting at our seats after entering.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your seats are next to each other in the same section and suggest entering separately and meeting at the seats. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入場前にお互いの席番号を確認しておくとよいですね。手荷物について案内を読みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be good to confirm each other's seat numbers before entering. Have you read the baggage guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物は小さいリュックだけです。券に載った注意の文字が細かいので、確認する場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小リュックのみと伝え細字の注意を確認できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only have a small backpack. The caution text on the ticket is tiny, so please tell me where I can check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you only have a small backpack and ask where you can read the cautions printed in small type. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では、入口横の大きな案内表示で手荷物の説明を見られます。受付前に読んで、不明な所を係へ尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this scenario, you can read the baggage information on the large sign beside the entrance. Read it before the reception point and ask staff about anything unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に大きな表示を読みます。友人が迷ったとき、私が入場後に外へ戻って迎えられるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示を先に読むと答え迷った友人を外へ迎えに戻れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll read the large sign first. I'd also like to know whether, after entering, I can go back outside to meet my friend if they get lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the sign first and ask whether you can go back outside to meet a friend who gets lost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 外へ戻って再び入れるかは、その案内だけでは判断できません。入場担当に確認してから動きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That guidance alone doesn't tell us whether you can go outside and reenter. Check with the entrance staff before taking action.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出入りは自己判断せず担当に聞きます。友人には、まず自分の入口で確認し、席で合流する案を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出入りは係へ聞き友人は指定入口で確認して席合流と伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the staff instead of deciding for myself about going in and out. I'll tell my friend to check at their assigned entrance first and suggest meeting at our seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask staff about entry and exit and tell your friend to check at their designated entrance and meet at the seats. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、北入口の表示を確認してから入場担当へお進みください。それでは、試合を楽しんでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the north entrance sign, then proceed to the entrance staff. Enjoy the match.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はこの見本を見ながら、採る実を相談します。色以外に、大きさも比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we'll use this sample to discuss which fruit to pick. Compare the size as well as the color.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本と同じ色ですが、かなり小さい実があります。色が合っていれば採ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本と同色だが小さい実を色だけで採れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's some very small fruit with the same color as the sample. May I pick it as long as the color matches?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may pick small fruit that matches the sample's color based on color alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 色だけでは決めず、その実を採る前に私へ見せてください。どの木にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't decide by color alone; show me the fruit before picking it. Which tree is it on?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二列目の入口側の木です。手が届きますが、まだ枝から取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二列目入口側で手が届くが採らず残していると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the tree near the entrance in the second row. I can reach it, but I haven't taken it off the branch yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is on the entrance side of the second row, within reach, but you have left it unpicked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままにして一緒に見ましょう。今日は自分で判断しにくい実を残して、位置を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Leave it there and let's look together. Today, leave fruit you find hard to judge and record its location.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 位置を記録します。残す実がある木には、目印を付ける方法も決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 位置を記録すると答え未収穫の木に目印を付ける方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll record the location. Is there also a set method for marking trees with fruit we're leaving unpicked?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the location and ask how to mark trees with unpicked fruit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この練習では、担当者が木の番号を一覧に記します。枝に勝手にひもを結ばないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this exercise, the person in charge writes the tree number on a list. Don't tie string onto branches on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 枝には結ばず、木の番号を伝えます。すでに箱に入れた実で大きさが違う物を見つけたら、同じ箱のまま相談してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 枝へ結ばず番号を伝え箱内の大きさ違いを移さず相談できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't tie anything to the branches; I'll report the tree number. If I find fruit of a different size already in a box, may I ask about it without moving it to another box?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will report the number without tying anything to branches, and ask whether you can consult about different-sized fruit in a box without moving it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱を混ぜ直さず、どの箱のどの部分かを教えてください。こちらで見てから分け方を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't remix the boxes; tell me which box and which part of it. We'll look at it before deciding how to sort it.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい実は採らず木の番号を知らせます。箱の中の違いも勝手に移さず、場所を示して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小さい実を採らず番号を知らせ箱の実も動かさず位置を示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the small fruit unpicked and report the tree number. I won't move different fruit in the box myself either; I'll point out its location and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the small fruit unpicked, report the number, and point out the location of fruit in the box without moving it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二列目の木へ一緒に行きましょう。それでは、見本との比べ方をそこで続けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's go to the tree in the second row together. I'll continue explaining how to compare it with the sample there.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: まず道具を並べてから練習しましょう。普段、どちらの手で字を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's lay out the tools before practicing. Which hand do you usually write with?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左手です。見本どおり右側に墨を置くと、腕が紙の上を通りそうですが、位置を変えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左利きで右側の墨だと腕が紙を通るため位置変更を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My left hand. If I put the ink on the right as in the sample, my arm looks likely to pass over the paper. May I change its position?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are left-handed and ink on the right would make your arm pass over the paper, and ask to change its position. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使いやすい位置を相談しましょう。紙を動かす場所が残るよう、墨の容器をこちら側へ寄せてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's discuss a position that's comfortable for you. Try moving the ink container toward this side, leaving space to move the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この位置なら腕が紙を横切りません。紙を押さえる重しも、左側に置いてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 墨の位置が改善したと答え重しを左側へ置けるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: In this position my arm won't cross the paper. May I put the paperweight on the left too?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the new ink position works better and ask whether you may put the paperweight on the left. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重しが書く手に当たらないか、筆を持たずに動きを確かめましょう。置く前に袖も机に触れていないか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your hand movements without holding a brush to see whether the weight will touch your writing hand. Before setting it down, also check whether your sleeves touch the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袖を上げて、手の動きを確かめます。書いた紙を次の紙に重ねず、乾かす場所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袖を上げ動きを確認し書いた紙を重ねず乾かす場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll pull up my sleeves and check my hand movements. Where can I dry the paper I've written on without stacking it on the next sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will raise your sleeves and check your movements, and ask where to dry written sheets without stacking them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 奥の乾燥台です。紙を運ぶ前に名前を小さく書いて、だれの作品か区別します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: On the drying rack at the back. Before carrying your paper there, write your name in small letters so we can tell whose work it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前を書いて乾燥台へ置きます。失敗した練習紙も同じ場所へ持って行くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作品に名前を付け乾燥台へ運び失敗した紙も同じ扱いか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write my name and put it on the drying rack. Do unsuccessful practice sheets go in the same place?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put your name on your work and take it to the drying rack, and ask whether unsuccessful sheets are handled the same way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 練習紙は横の箱へ置き、残したい作品だけ乾燥台へ運びます。どちらか迷ったら机に置いて声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Put practice sheets in the box beside it and take only work you want to keep to the drying rack. If you're unsure which it is, leave it on the desk and call me.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 練習紙と残す作品を分け、迷った紙は机で見てもらいます。道具の位置を確かめてから書き始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 練習と作品を分け迷った紙を見てもらい配置確認後に書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separate practice sheets from work I want to keep and ask you to look at any uncertain sheets on the desk. I'll check the tool arrangement before starting to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate practice sheets and finished work, have uncertain sheets checked, and begin writing after checking the arrangement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、最初の線を一緒に書きましょう。それでは、道具を整えてからまた呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you're ready, let's write the first line together. Arrange your tools and call me again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人で取り分ける料理をお考えですね。注文をまとめる前に、お聞きしておくことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're considering a dish for the two of you to share. Is there anything you'd like to ask before we put the order together?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は落花生のアレルギーがあります。友人と同じ皿を分ける前に、たれの材料を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落花生のアレルギーを示し同皿を分ける前にたれの材料を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a peanut allergy. Before sharing a dish with my friend, I'd like to check the sauce ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a peanut allergy and ask about the sauce ingredients before sharing a dish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このメニューにはたれの細かな材料まではありません。料理名を伺って、調理担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This menu doesn't list the detailed sauce ingredients. Tell me the dish and I'll check with the kitchen staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼き物のたれです。たれを外せばよいと決めず、下味や添える物もわかる範囲で聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 焼き物のたれと示し除去だけで判断せず下味と添え物も確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the sauce for the grilled dish. Please don't assume removing the sauce is enough; ask about the seasoning and accompaniments too, as far as you can find out.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the grilled dish's sauce and ask staff to check the seasoning and accompaniments too, without deciding that simply removing the sauce is sufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 下味と添える物も問い合わせます。確認がそろうまで、この料理の注文は入れずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask about the seasoning and accompaniments too. I won't place the order for this dish until we've gathered the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の注文を保留にしてください。友人の分と一緒にしてしまわないよう、別々に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の分は保留し友人の注文とまとめず別相談にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please put my order on hold. I'd like to discuss mine separately so it doesn't get combined with my friend's order.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to hold your order and discuss it separately instead of combining it with your friend's. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別々の用件として伺います。友人の方が先に注文したい場合も、同じ皿で分ける前提にはしないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll handle these as separate requests. Even if your friend wants to order first, I'll confirm that we're not assuming you will share the same dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人にも、私が食べられるかはまだわからないと伝えます。確認できなかった材料は、不明だと明確に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ食べられるか未確定と知らせ不明な材料は不明と教えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my friend we still don't know whether I can eat it. Please clearly identify any ingredients you couldn't verify as unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your friend it is still uncertain whether you can eat it, and ask to be clearly told which ingredients remain unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた情報と不明な部分を分けてお伝えします。ここで安全に食べられると保証することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll distinguish the verified information from what remains unknown. I can't guarantee here that you can eat it safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 情報がそろっても、自分で判断できなければ注文を見送ります。今は私の分を確定せず、担当の返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 判断できなければ見送り今は確定せず担当返答を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Even if all the information is gathered, I'll skip ordering if I can't judge for myself. For now, don't finalize my order; I'll wait for the kitchen's response.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will skip ordering if you cannot decide, leave your order unconfirmed for now, and wait for the staff's response. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、私がお返事を確認してきます。それでは、注文を保留のままこちらでお待ちください。戻りましたらまた伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-IIZUKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll go and check on the response. Please wait here with the order still on hold. I'll come back and speak to you again.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 加工前の資料をそろえましょう。机の図面を見て、気づいたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's gather the documents before processing. Looking at the drawings on the desk, have you noticed anything?

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ部品の図面が二枚ありますが、右下の版番号が違います。どちらを渡せばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ部品の図面二枚の版番号が違い渡すものを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two drawings for the same part, but their revision numbers in the lower right differ. Which one should I hand over?
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two drawings of the same part have different revision numbers, and ask which to hand over. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 責任者が使う版を確かめます。今はどちらも機械の担当者へ渡さず、ここに置いてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check which revision the supervisor wants used. For now, don't give either drawing to the machine operator; leave them here.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ渡していません。材料も並べていますが、寸法を測るところまで進めてよいですか。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図面は未配布で材料の測定まで進めるかを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't handed them over yet. I'm also laying out the materials; may I go as far as measuring their dimensions?
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the drawings have not been handed out and ask whether you may proceed to measuring the materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 測定の担当範囲も確認してからにしましょう。今日は機械の操作を頼まれていますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's first check whose responsibilities include measuring. Have you been asked to operate the machine today?

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 機械は操作しないと聞いています。材料を準備する担当ですが、測定を含むかは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 操作は担当せず材料準備に測定を含むか未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've been told I won't operate the machine. I'm in charge of preparing materials, but I haven't been told whether that includes measuring.
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are not assigned machine operation and have not checked whether preparing materials includes measuring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では担当を確認するまで準備を保留しましょう。加工中に資料の違いに気づいたら、誰に知らせますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's put preparation on hold until we've checked your responsibilities. If you notice a discrepancy in the documents during processing, whom will you tell?

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 操作している人と責任者に知らせたいです。自分で機械の設定を変えず、停止が必要か判断をお願いするということですか。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当者と責任者に知らせ停止の判断を頼む方針を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to tell the operator and the supervisor. Does that mean I shouldn't change the machine settings myself, but should ask them to decide whether it needs to stop?
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the approach of informing the operator and supervisor and asking them to decide whether to stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者へすぐ伝え、現場で教わった停止と報告の手順に従ってください。今日使う手順の説明も受けましょう。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the operator immediately and follow the stopping and reporting procedures taught at this workplace. Let's also have the procedures for today explained to you.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図面の版と自分の担当を確認し、停止と報告の説明を聞きます。確認が済むまで材料は動かしません。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図面と担当と報告手順を確認するまで材料を動かさないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the drawing revision and my responsibilities and listen to the stopping and reporting instructions. I won't move the materials until those checks are complete.
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not move the materials until you have checked the drawing, your responsibilities, and the reporting procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 責任者を呼んできますので、この机でお待ちください。資料がそろったら、またここで打ち合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-FKO-KITAKYUSHU-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the supervisor, so please wait at this desk. Once the documents are ready, let's meet here again.
